result:
I graded submission s2 for quiz 0001 and wrote the grades to `grades/0001-s2.json`. You got 3 correct, 2 partial and 1 wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Feedback |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | Correct | The loop of choosing an action, running it and feeding the result back is what makes a system an agent. |
| q2 | Correct | The model only writes a request naming the tool and its arguments. Your program runs the tool. |
| q3 | Wrong (M6) | This agent would repeat the same failing step forever. A step limit is the safeguard, and it also saves model calls on your budget. |
| q4 | Partial (M4) | Your count of 4 is right, but the model doesn't run the tools. It writes a request, your program runs the tool, and the result goes into the next call. |
| q5 | Correct | Both parts are there: the result goes back in as the next input, and the model uses it to decide its next step. |
| q6 | Partial | The name is part of it, but the model chooses from the full description: name, purpose and parameters. |

**Summary:** You have the loop itself down. Two things to fix:
- An agent needs a stopping condition, such as a step limit.
- The program runs the tools, and the model picks them from their full descriptions, not just their names.

I also added learning record `0003` and updated `NOTES.md`. s1 is still ungraded.
